The '''Caves of Masposhani''' were extensive caverns running under the planet [[Masposhani]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. According to [[Beldorion]] the Hutt, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] once maintained training facilities in these subterranean passages.<ref name="Planet of Twilight">''[[Planet of Twilight]]''</ref>
